title: Generating from Discrete Distributions Using Diffusions: Insights from Random Constraint Satisfaction Problems
abstract: arXiv:2603.20589v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generating data from discrete distributions is important for a number of application domains including text, tabular data, and genomic data. Several groups have recently used random $k$-satisfiability ($k$-SAT) as a synthetic benchmark for new generative techniques. In this paper, we show that fundamental insights from the theory of random constraint satisfaction problems have observable implications (sometime contradicting intuition) on the behavior of generative techniques on such benchmarks. More precisely, we study the problem of generating a uniformly random solution of a given (random) $k$-SAT or $k$-XORSAT formula. Among other findings, we observe that: $(i)$~Continuous diffusions outperform masked discrete diffusions; $(ii)$~Learned diffusions can match the theoretical `ideal' accuracy; $(iii)$~Smart ordering of the variables can significantly improve accuracy, although not following popular heuristics.

translated_title: 使用扩散模型从离散分布中生成数据：来自随机约束满足问题的洞察
translated_abstract: 从离散分布中生成数据对于文本、表格数据和基因组数据等众多应用领域都至关重要。近期有多个研究团队使用随机k-可满足性（k-SAT）问题作为新式生成技术的合成基准。在本文中，我们表明随机约束满足问题理论中的基本洞察对生成技术在此类基准上的行为具有可观察的影响（有时甚至与直觉相悖）。更确切地说，我们研究了为给定的（随机）k-SAT或k-XORSAT公式生成均匀随机解的问题。在诸多发现中，我们观察到：(i) 连续扩散模型优于掩码离散扩散模型；(ii) 学习到的扩散模型可以达到理论上“理想”的精度；(iii) 对变量进行智能排序可以显著提升精度，尽管这种排序并非遵循流行的启发式方法。
tldr: 本研究以随机k-SAT问题作为生成模型基准，发现连续扩散模型优于掩码离散扩散模型，学习到的扩散模型可达到理论理想精度，且智能变量排序能显著提升生成精度。
en_tdlr: Using random k-SAT problems as benchmarks for generative models, this study shows that continuous diffusions outperform masked discrete diffusions, learned diffusions can match theoretical ideal accuracy, and smart variable ordering significantly improves accuracy, though not by following popular heuristics.
